negative_controls.description: Naive injection of 40 above-threshold capabilities overflows; the budgeter on the same list stays under the ceiling. A missing ceiling would fail the budgeted half; a vacuous fixture that never overflowed would fail the naive half.

counter=$((counter+10)) inside command substitution leaves the parent counter at 0; the same increment in the main shell yields 10.

question_or_target: Implement the injection budgeter: a per-capability token-cost model, a hard total ceiling, and a refusal to inject past it. Exact target: reproduce and then prevent the measured skills-context-budget overflow that was the root cause of naive-session behavior, and prove the ceiling holds when 40 capabilities all score above threshold.
